base_image_note: nicholasfreitas/cuda_micromamba_base:cuda12.2.0-base-ubuntu22.04-micromamba is published locally on the host daemon; PyTorch wheels bundle their own CUDA 12 runtime so the base tag does not restrict the compute stack.

checkpoints.description: CD+BB+BN - Main model used for experiments in paper

synspace.description: SynSpace chemical space (44,944 building blocks, 3 reactions)

build_gotchas: Apptainer mounts the image read-only, so ReferenceGeometry must precompile ligands_geometry_values.p and ligands_geometry_kernel_densities.p into /app/data/validity3d during the build; otherwise runtime fails with [Errno 30] Read-only file system.
reduce must be present on PATH as 'reduce' for interactions_local evaluation.
gnina binary v1.1 must be present on PATH as 'gnina' for CNN affinity / Vina scoring.
mksquashfs on this host must be invoked with --mksquashfs-args '-mem 512M -processors 2' to avoid OOM-killer under Slurm.
All Torch/Triton/HF caches must be redirected to /tmp in %environment because Apptainer SIF filesystem is read-only.

validation.note: Complete isolation: no host $HOME, no host /tmp, no route to internet.
